docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY JIMENEZ, SANDRA AS TO DEFENDANT STERN, ZALMAN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-07-2022 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506

PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$40.00); REMARKS: ZALMAN STERN CAME TO SAN FRANCISCO CITY HALL RM456 AND WAS SERVED. SERVED MAR-02-2022, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT STERN, ZALMAN

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-07-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO MAY-13-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF SANDRA JIMENEZ IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ZALMAN STERN IS PRESENT. PROOF OF SERVICE IS ON FILE. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $8115 (INCLUDES COSTS) TO THE PLAINTIFF. THE DEFENDANT WILL NOT USE THE DESIGNS OR WORK PRODUCT OF THE PLAINTIFF. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE MAY 13TH HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER TO CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.
ORDER TO DISMISS CASE WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
